data.content_ref: inline:The proposed 'refuted if' condition is too narrow to substantiate the claimed contradiction between SRC_005 and SRC_003. The problem asks what evidence distinguishes genuine reliability from mere compliance; SRC_001 only names one failure mode (correct-to-incorrect flip under perturbation) but never states what specifically is REFUTED — it leaves the relation (what is refuted if the condition holds) implicit, and the perturbation test alone cannot show that the non-expert panel is *more reliable on average*, only that compliance and reliability can diverge in one direction.
